fields.label: Pemungut Customer Groups
Output VAT Accounts
fields.description: Accounts that represent PPN Keluaran. On a government (pemungut/WAPU) invoice, Taxes and Charges rows posting to these accounts are removed — the buyer deposits that PPN itself, so charging it again would double-count it. Other charges (freight/Ongkos Kirim, packing, handling) are never touched. Leave empty to detect output VAT automatically (account type "Tax" with root type "Liability").
Default account and rate per company for each kind of government-collected tax (Piutang PPN Bendahara, PPh 22 Dibayar di Muka). Used to pre-fill a charge the accountant adds to an invoice.
fields.label: Government Tax Defaults
Taxable Charges on the Faktur
fields.description: A charge billed INSIDE the PPN base — freight taxed by an "On Previous Row Total" PPN row — is part of the DPP but is not an item, so it needs its own faktur line. Map each such account here. Charges billed outside the PPN need no mapping.
